definitions.explanation: A defensive player in baseball who is not the pitcher or catcher. Refers collectively to the seven position players in the field: first baseman, second baseman, shortstop, third baseman, left fielder, center fielder, and right fielder.

examples.japanese: {野手|やしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦エラー→エラー：08429_eraa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{野手|やしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転向|てんこう}→転向：19314_tenkou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That player converted from pitcher to fielder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドラフト→ドラフト：30282_dorafuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{即戦力|そくせんりょく}→即戦力：17917_sokusenryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{野手|やしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指名|しめい}→指名：12868_shimei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧だ。
examples.english: The plan for this year's draft is to mainly select fielders who can contribute immediately.

notes:
USAGE:
A baseball term. {野手|やしゅ} specifically excludes the battery (⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧ pitcher and ⟦{捕手|ほしゅ}→捕手：09265_hoshu⟧ catcher). Can be further divided into ⟦{内野手|ないやしゅ}→内野手：25025_naiyashu⟧ (infielder) and ⟦{外野手|がいやしゅ}→外野手：21674_gaiyashu⟧ (outfielder).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{内野手|ないやしゅ}→内野手：25025_naiyashu⟧ (infielder)
- ⟦{外野手|がいやしゅ}→外野手：21674_gaiyashu⟧ (outfielder)
- {野手|やしゅ}⟦{転向|てんこう}→転向：19314_tenkou⟧ (conversion to fielder)
- ⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{野手|やしゅ} (defensive specialist fielder)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧: pitcher — the player who throws the ball
- ⟦{捕手|ほしゅ}→捕手：09265_hoshu⟧: catcher — the player behind home plate
